llm_justification.summary: A sharp increase in the implied probability that Xi Jinping is removed from power would most plausibly signal acute Chinese political instability, driving a near-term risk-off move in Chinese equities (FXI down) and a weaker offshore yuan (CYB down / USD/CNH up). However, such leadership-change markets are extremely noisy with very low base rates, so confidence is modest and the equity move only reaches tradable magnitude if a credible public signal emerges. This is a research mapping, not a high-conviction call.
